name: Hilkiah
overview: Hilkiah was a male Levite, specifically a descendant of the Merarite clan through Mushi, son of Merari, who was one of Levi's sons. He is uniquely identified as the son of Amzi, situating him within the Levitical genealogies. His tribal affiliation and lineage connect him to the priestly duties assigned to the Levites in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Hilkiah means 'YHWH is [my] portion,' reflecting a personal acknowledgment of God's provision and ownership. This proper name, found in 1 Chronicles 6:45, does not indicate that it was given directly by God but carries a meaningful declaration of faith in the LORD as one's inheritance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Hilkiah as the son of Amzi, and it is inferred that Amaziah is his father, establishing a clear paternal lineage. These relationships place Hilkiah firmly within the Levitical family line, important for understanding his role and heritage.
scriptureSignificance: Hilkiah's significance lies in his Levitical descent, specifically from the Merarite branch, which was entrusted with particular responsibilities in the service of the tabernacle and later the temple. Being identified as the son of Amzi highlights his place in the genealogical record that preserves the continuity of priestly service. His name's meaning underscores a Christ-centered truth that the LORD is the believer's portion and inheritance.
